rule_label: policy-author-gap: a fixture policy variant permits more than its author intent while matching configuration
explanation: fixture policy variant 'allow-list-empty-string-member' permits an empty-string argument (probe 'list-member-empty-string') although the author intent bounds every exercised value to the named accounts list. Classification: fixture policy issue, not a gate gap - the gate enforced its documented per-field contract. Reason: 'ok'
suggested_action: authoring recipe: name every security-critical field in the allow constraint map, prefer allowed_values whitelists over forbidden_values blacklists

rule_label: http-transport-parity-verified: HTTP and in-process decisions matched for every parity probe (PASS)
explanation: transport parity verified: 4 parity probes returned identical decisions and policy ids over HTTP and in-process (loopback); malformed trace headers rejected at transport without a 5xx; oversized payload rejected.
suggested_action: re-run this suite whenever the gateway /gate preprocessing changes; the in-process/HTTP pair is the parity contract

rule_label: mcp-uri-traversal-allowed: an MCP resource URI carrying path traversal was allowed
explanation: a file:// resource URI escaping the policy prefix was allowed: file:///ledger/coversheets/././.. (decision from a starts_with prefix policy). The prefix operator matches the literal string while the URI layer resolves the escape the policy text never sees; classified as a policy authoring gap on the URI layer, not a gate DSL gap.
suggested_action: constrain resource URIs with resolved-path predicates (normalise, then match) in the tool layer wrapping the gate, or add a canonical-path operator to the policy DSL

rule_label: receipt-replay-attributable: replay detection by receipt_hash equality verified (PASS)
explanation: replay of a real receipt for a different claimed trace id is attributable: receipt_hash equality identifies the resubmission and the signed x_gate trace binding exposes the discrepancy
suggested_action: none: detection confirmed; monitor the index for duplicate hashes
